data.name: Nubla
data.gender_notes: Nubla is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘nubal’, meaning ‘light’ or ‘grace’. Nubla is a name of spiritual significance in Islamic culture, symbolizing the inner light that illuminates the path to knowledge and wisdom. It is also a name of grace and beauty, evoking images of the radiant moon and the gentle breeze. The name Nubla carries the meaning “Light, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nubla usually hope their child will grow to embody light, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner light and guidance in the Islamic spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Nubla belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nubla total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
